name: How is quality controlled during a ground-up build?

mainEntity.name: How is quality controlled during a ground-up build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quality is managed through detailed plans and specs, pre-construction coordination, inspections at key milestones, on-site supervision, and addressing issues quickly as work progresses. calahan+2
